project_name.justification: Troubadour Resources Inc. ... has executed an option ... with Xander Resources Inc. ... for the right to purchase an undivided 100% interest in 173 mineral claims comprising Xander's Senneville Project (the "Project)...

company_name.justification: Troubadour Resources Inc. (TSXV: TR) (OTC PINK: TROUF) ("TR" or the "Company"), a North American mineral acquisition and exploration company...

ceo_buyer.justification: "The rising global demand for copper... makes the acquisition of the Senneville Gold-Copper Property an attractive investment," said Blake Morgan, CEO of Troubadour Resources.

interest_acquired_percent.justification: Pursuant to the Option Agreement (the "Agreement"), the Company may acquire a 100% interest in the Property...

primary_commodity.justification: Troubadour Resources Options Significant Quebec Land Package with Highly Prospective Gold and Copper Targets

verified_article_link.justification: The article is about Troubadour Resources Inc. optioning the Senneville Project, which matches the project of interest.

currency.justification: The buyer, Troubadour Resources Inc., trades on the TSX Venture Exchange (TSXV: TR) and the work commitment is listed in dollars ('$2,000,000 in work expenditures'), implying Canadian Dollars (CAD).

cash_payments_raw.justification: The terms of the agreement do not mention any cash payments, only share issuances and work commitments.

share_payments_raw.justification: Per the financial data extraction hierarchy, this field is null because the number of shares and a price per share are available to populate `amount_of_shares_issued` and `issued_share_price`.

cash_and_share_payments_combined_raw.justification: Per the financial data extraction hierarchy, this field is null because the payment components are broken down into shares and work commitments.

amount_of_shares_issued.justification: ...the Company may acquire a 100% interest in the Property by issuing an aggregate of 5,000,000 common shares in the capital of the Company...

share_warrant_payments_raw.justification: No share warrants are mentioned as part of the transaction terms.

option_payments_raw.justification: While the agreement is an option agreement, there are no payments specified as 'option payments' in the terms.

issued_share_price.justification: The transaction terms mention the number of shares issued but not a specific price ('Shares of the Company are to be issued at a deemed value based on the Discounted Market Price at the time of issuance'). Using the last traded price as a fallback, as seen in the detailed quote: 'Last: 0.025'.

exploration_commitment_meters.justification: The agreement specifies a monetary work commitment, not a commitment in meters of drilling.

exploration_commitment_value_raw.justification: ...the Company may acquire a 100% interest in the Property by issuing an aggregate of 5,000,000 common shares in the capital of the Company and complete $2,000,000 in work expenditures...

nsr_acquired_percent.justification: The buyer will assume existing royalties on the property: 'The Project has the following net-smelter returns royalties (the "NSR") which will be assumed by the Company: 2% NSR to North American Exploration Ltd. for 72 claims...'

resource_size.justification: The text explicitly states that no resource exists: 'the Company currently has no reserves on any of its properties.'
